title: Covered
description: An ally is covering you. All attacks that would be directed to you are redirected to them instead.
smart_description: [gold]{Applier}[/gold] is covering you. All attacks that would be directed to you are redirected to them instead.
notes: Automatically applies or reinforces an Intercept power on the ally covering you. Removed when the covering ally dies or at the end of enemy turns.
